standard-dialogue-after-the-blood-moon-r.npc: Well met, [player name]. Fancy a drink?

options.text: Do I get a friends discount?

steps.player: Do I get a friends discount?

steps.npc: See how the walls are still falling down?
Good. Then you see why there are no discounts here. Now, want that drink?
Not too bad. Business isn't the fastest here unsurprisingly, but I still get plenty of people stopping off on route from Paterdomus to the Theatre of Blood.
Some have suggested we don't stock a wide enough range of drinks, but others seem quite appreciative of the lack of nonsense on the menu.

steps.player: Well, I'm glad the pub is doing well, but I was actually asking about you.

steps.npc: Me? Oh, I'm fine. The war is over and we mostly won. I'm finally getting to enjoy some peace and quiet.
Happy? I wouldn't go that far. I'd be happier if the vampyres were gone completely and Safalaan wasn't now one himself, but given all that happened, I'll take what I can get.
Safalaan? No. He's come here a few times, but I've made it clear I won't be setting foot in Darkmeyer ever again. The vampyres may still be around, but my days of breaking bread with them are done.
Anyway, enough about all that. How about a drink?
Yeah, he comes to visit a fair bit. Sometimes without Drezel's permission, I suspect...

steps.player: And everything's good between the two of you?

steps.npc: We've... talked, if that's what you're getting at?
The importance of a good drink. So, fancy giving the questioning a rest and buying one?
Oh, don't mind if I do!
